Fine-tuning

The fine-tune job lifecycle

Create a job, then follow its status

POST /api/fine-tuning/jobs
queued
loading_model
loading_dataset
training
saving
completed
stoppedfailedcan end a job. Progress as SSE:GET .../jobs/{id}/progress

Then export

POST /api/fine-tuning/jobs/{id}/export
loraadapter only
merged_16bitfull model, 16-bit
merged_4bitfull model, 4-bit
ggufready for llama.cpp
Fine-tuning is an add-on. An admin turns it on per user.
